name: rust-code
description: Rust in the style of BeautifulRust, built on six enforced pillars: a domain type system that refuses primitives, event-driven sans-IO cores, layered crates, zero-copy, no_std and no unsafe -- plus the research, measurement and QA method behind them. Pairs with rust-template, whose gates enforce every rule.

gate_on_edit.title: Run the gates after each Rust edit
gate_on_edit.description: After Claude edits a .rs file in a project with rust-template's gates, run `cargo xtask budgets` and `cargo xtask arch` and show Claude what they find. Runs commands in your project, so it is off until you turn it on.
